title: How One Log Made 100 Soldiers Surrender #history #shorts
description:
In December 1780, more than a hundred Loyalist soldiers were holed up in a fortified log barn at Rugeley's Mill, South Carolina. William Washington had about eighty men and no cannon. So he had a pine log cut down, blackened one end, set it on wheels and aimed it at the barn. The garrison surrendered without a shot being fired. When Lord Cornwallis heard, he wrote: "Rugeley will not be made a brigadier."

The conversation inside the barn is dramatized. Washington's men were cavalry; they are drawn on foot.

#history #shorts #americanrevolution
